title: memorable experience
text:
All the dishes were excellent, but it was really Hadrien, the guide, who made the difference. His enthusiasm for sharing his knowledge and his love for Granada touched us a lot. It is definitely a highlight of our trip, and
even afterwards, since we will follow up on some lines of thought that Hadrien started us on.
author: mysbe

title: Amazing food tour in Granada
text: What a great tour! Emma was an amazing guide, and the choice of restaurants and selection of food and drinks was really outstanding. I would highly recommend this tour.
author: William_R

title: Wouldn’t hesitate to book this, great evening!!
text: Emma was a fabulous guide, the restaurants chosen were all awesome and I thoroughly enjoyed every dish and drink!
author: Tamara_M

title: Probably the best food  tour I’ve ever been on
text: Emma is a Granadina with an encyclopaedic knowledge of her home city and its rich, historic food scene. The tour is more structured than most, and it focused on dishes shaped by multicultural influences and working-class traditions that I'd never have found alone, made with incredible local produce and each paired with a well-chosen drink. The group was small, which encouraged real engagement. Highly recommended.
author: thelauraoneill

title: Must do in Granada
text: Our guide Juan Miguel was just fantastic, very knowledgeable. We visited 4 tapas spots and the food was substantial and  delicious. A great introduction to Granada and its food. And very reasonably priced.
author: Bolwarra

title: Great Tapas, drinks with an excellent guide
text:
Hadrien our guide was an absolute delight with his knowledge and passion for all things Granada and Andalusia.
Great stops, excellent drink and great tapas... Very enjoyable with 6 of us on the 3 hour plus tour
Highly recommend
author: Culture730645

title: Fun food and drink
text: Had a great time with guide Emma and a small group of 7. She took us to places locals eat at with a really good variety of tapas and nice drinks for each. It was a very fun evening, highly recommended.
author: Shejdkdbtkshfjro

title: An Unforgettable Taste of Spain
text: This was an absolutely fantastic experience from start to finish! Our host, Emma, was incredible, and the food made with fresh, local produce was simply amazing. Getting to meet new people, try authentic new dishes, and truly experience Spain was unforgettable. I highly recommend this to anyone looking for a great time!
author: skawad

title: A great evening tasting different food and drinks.
text: Our guide was very knowledgeable and we enjoyed her commentary. The stops were places that locals frequent.
author: brucef845

title: Local Food, Drinks and Culture
text: This was a great food tour! Juan, our guide,  was very friendly and engaging! The tour not only provided delicious food and drinks, but also the local culture behind them, which was super interesting! I would highly recommend!
author: Kathy_B
